title: World Cup final, 1966
pool: England's starting XI against West Germany at Wembley, 30 July 1966. Clubs are the ones they were at on the day.
_notes: SOURCE CHANGED. This pointed at the squads page, which proves the clubs but
does not contain the eleven — so the board's central claim, who played, was
not backed by the URL it carried. It now points at the final, whose lineup
table gives the XI and the positions and matches this board exactly.
Clubs still come from the squads page:
The board that proves the hint rule works in the other direction. All
eleven are English, so nationality sells nothing and the build refuses it;
the clubs run from Blackpool to Leeds and are worth paying for.
TWO CHARLTONS. Authored with forenames because their surnames scramble to
the same tiles, and two identical tiles cannot be told apart on the pitch
or by the marker. Neither carries CHARLTON as an alias for the same reason
— an alias that would match either slot is a wrong answer accepted.
Ball was still a Blackpool player on the day: he signed for Everton on 18
August 1966, three weeks after the final.
